department: Wayne H. King Department of Chemical and Environmental Engineering

deadline.value: International graduate application deadline for Fall entry is June 1, 2027 (apply earlier for assistantship/fellowship consideration; financial aid priority deadline is January 15).
deadline.quote: Fall applications must be submitted by June 1

gre_general.value: Effective Summer 2024 onwards, the Frank H. Dotterweich College of Engineering does not require the GRE for graduate admissions (superseding older departmental catalog/webpage text).
gre_general.quote: effective Summer 2024 onwards | GRE: GRE is not required for admissions.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics, and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Contacting faculty and the Doctoral Graduate Coordinator is recommended; for direct B.S.-to-Ph.D. admission, a faculty member must be willing to advise the student (otherwise admission is conditional on earning an M.S. degree).
supervisor.quote: Student must have faculty willing to advise the student; otherwise, the student would be provisionally admitted into the Ph.D. program with a condition that they obtain an M.S. degree.

funding.value: Competitive TA, RA, and fellowship support is available through faculty grants and department/graduate resources; for direct B.S.-to-Ph.D. admission, faculty supervisor funding guarantees admission.
funding.quote: If a faculty member agrees to supervise and fund a student, the student should be admitted. | who has received any form of support from TAMUK (e.g., TA, RA, fellowship, etc.)

entry_route.value: Minimum requirement is a baccalaureate degree; M.S. entrants complete 63 credits (or reduced coursework for TAMUK Environmental Engineering M.S. graduates), while direct B.S.-to-Ph.D. entrants complete 93 credits.
entry_route.quote: Students must hold a minimum of a baccalaureate degree | Specific Admission Requirements for Direct B.S. to Ph.D. Route | A direct admit Ph.D. student is required to complete a total of 93 credits, including at least 42 credits of didactic coursework to fulfill the degree requirements.

also.quote: Completion of a minimum of 63 credit hours: 24 to 36 credit hours of classroom graduate-level courses, 6 credit hours of graduate seminar, and 21 to 33 credit hours of research.

notes: Includes the Environmental Sustainability and Resilience, Ph.D. track.
name: Environmental Engineering, Ph.D.
